verdict.rationale: Slack ships Slackbot as a built-in personal AI agent. Per Slack's own pages, it prepares for meetings, analyzes reports, creates project briefs, updates deals on request, digs into open-ended questions, and routes requests to agents with results delivered back. Built-in AI also summarizes channels and threads and takes huddle notes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works reliably, in-depth first-party documentation of Slackbot's task-execution scope and limits beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Slackbot is your personal AI agent in Slack that understands you and your workspace, helping you prepare for upcoming meetings, analyze reports, and create project briefs.
Update deals just by asking Slackbot
Route work through Slackbot. Coordinate work by routing requests to agents and get results delivered right back into your workflow.
Slackbot can now dig deep on open-ended questions, not just quick ones.
AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve up daily recaps
